quests.title: Asset 0041, Condition Fair
quests.blurb: Asset 0041 on the register is the Coogee Pier. The sea took it in 1934. It has been inspected every year since, it is rated condition fair, and this year that is you. Bring a camera and the heights ticket.

steps.label: sit the working at heights ticket, because 0041 is a structure over water
photograph Asset 0041 at its registered coordinates: High Cross Park, Randwick, 1.6 km inland of the sea that ate it
receive two items of community feedback from the Friends of the Coogee Pier
photograph Asset 0041a, the kiosk, which drifted to Kingsford separately
log the leg by heavy rail; the travel schedule was last revised in 1979 and does not believe in the light rail
have the condition rating read out to you in person

one stop north, over the water, in car four where the vents actually work
from the Meadowbank bank, photograph the west face of the tower at the hour it cooks

get up to Willoughby Road before the eleven o'clock rush
buy a flat white; nobody suspects a man with a coffee

quests.title: One Blink in Eighteen Years
quests.blurb: Eighteen years I shot that family. One photo where Auntie blinked, and now I'm not invited to my own niece's wedding. I'm not going up there. You are. Go and finish the album.

steps.label: you'll be standing about for six hours. Get a coffee. Not the place on the corner, they know my face.
one stop. Don't walk it up Alice Street -- somebody up there knows my walk and you've got my camera bag.
the function centre on Wigram Street. Wide, from across the road, before the marigolds go up.
by nine two uncles will want to review your camera roll. Decline. Twice.
shoot the singles table while you're in there. They tip, and they tip in cash, and they tip badly.
the car does a lap of Church Street about nine. They think it's Bollywood. Be on the corner first.
bring the card back down to Granville. Not the app. The app ruins them.

quests.title: Fifteen People, No Amplified Sound
quests.blurb: It's a picnic. I've got the permit in a sleeve. Fifteen people, nine till five, no amplified sound. There's four hundred of them, six kilowatts and it's ten past two, so call it a permit with some give in it.

steps.label: the servo on the Princes Highway does a two a.m. flat white. It is not good. It is structural.

walk the bucket. It's a donation. Hold it at chest height, say the word donation, and money appears
the Mitchell Road townhouses have a decibel app and a printed copy of the noise regulation. Discuss it with two of them
first train out of St Peters, one stop, because the after is a terrace in Erskineville and everyone is pretending otherwise
back to the kilns before the sun clears the airport
